mapper.sql: select s.stock_id,s.warehouse_id,w.warehouse_code,w.warehouse_name,s.location_id,l.location_code,l.location_name,l.location_type,a.area_type, s.item_id,i.item_code,i.item_name,i.specification,i.unit,s.batch_no,s.production_date,s.expiry_date,s.quantity,s.locked_quantity, (s.quantity-s.locked_quantity) available_qty,i.min_stock, case when i.status='0' and i.min_stock>0 and (select coalesce(sum(sa.quantity-sa.locked_quantity),0) from wms_stock sa join wms_location sla on sla.location_id=sa.location_id join wms_area saa on saa.area_id=sla.area_id join wms_warehouse swa on swa.warehouse_id=sa.warehouse_id where sa.item_id=s.item_id and sa.warehouse_id=s.warehouse_id and sla.status='0' and sla.location_type!='DEFECTIVE' and saa.status='0' and saa.area_type in ('STORAGE','PICKING') and swa.status='0')<=i.min_stock then true else false end low_stock, s.update_time from wms_stock s left join wms_warehouse w on w.warehouse_id=s.warehouse_id left join wms_location l on l.location_id=s.location_id left join wms_area a on a.area_id=l.area_id left join wms_item i on i.item_id=s.item_id
mapper.select: and s.warehouse_id=#{warehouseId}and s.location_id=#{locationId} and s.item_id=#{itemId}and w.warehouse_code like concat('%',#{warehouseCode},'%') and l.location_code like concat('%',#{locationCode},'%') and i.item_code like concat('%',#{itemCode},'%') and i.item_name like concat('%',#{itemName},'%') and s.batch_no like concat('%',#{batchNo},'%') order by w.warehouse_code,l.location_code,i.item_code,s.batch_no

select null stock_id,w.warehouse_id,w.warehouse_code,w.warehouse_name,null location_id,null location_code,null location_name, i.item_id,i.item_code,i.item_name,i.specification,i.unit,null batch_no,null production_date,null expiry_date, coalesce(sum(s.quantity),0) quantity,coalesce(sum(s.locked_quantity),0) locked_quantity, coalesce(sum(s.quantity-s.locked_quantity),0) available_qty,i.min_stock,true low_stock,max(s.update_time) update_time from wms_stock s join wms_warehouse w on w.warehouse_id=s.warehouse_id join wms_item i on i.item_id=s.item_id join wms_location al on al.location_id=s.location_id join wms_area aa on aa.area_id=al.area_id where w.status='0' and i.status='0' and i.min_stock>0 and al.status='0' and al.location_type!='DEFECTIVE' and aa.status='0' and aa.area_type in ('STORAGE','PICKING') and w.warehouse_id=#{warehouseId} and i.item_id=#{itemId} and i.item_code like concat('%',#{itemCode},'%') and i.item_name like concat('%',#{itemName},'%') group by w.warehouse_id,w.warehouse_code,w.warehouse_name,i.item_id,i.item_code,i.item_name,i.specification,i.unit,i.min_stock having coalesce(sum(s.quantity-s.locked_quantity),0)<=i.min_stock order by w.warehouse_code,available_qty/i.min_stock,i.item_code

select m.movement_id,m.biz_type,m.biz_no,m.warehouse_id,w.warehouse_code,w.warehouse_name,m.location_id,l.location_code,l.location_name, m.item_id,i.item_code,i.item_name,i.specification,i.unit,m.batch_no,m.change_qty,m.balance_qty,m.operator,m.operation_time,m.remark from wms_stock_movement m left join wms_warehouse w on w.warehouse_id=m.warehouse_id left join wms_location l on l.location_id=m.location_id left join wms_item i on i.item_id=m.item_id and m.biz_type=#{bizType} and m.biz_no like concat('%',#{bizNo},'%') and m.warehouse_id=#{warehouseId}and m.location_id=#{locationId} and m.item_id=#{itemId}and i.item_code like concat('%',#{itemCode},'%')
and m.batch_no = coalesce(#{batchNo}, '') and m.batch_no like concat('%',#{batchNo},'%')
and m.operation_time >= #{params.beginTime} and m.operation_time < date_add(#{params.endTime}, interval 1 day) order by m.operation_time desc,m.movement_id desc
where s.warehouse_id=#{warehouseId} and s.location_id=#{locationId} and s.item_id=#{itemId} and s.batch_no=#{batchNo}
where s.warehouse_id=#{warehouseId} and s.location_id=#{locationId} and s.item_id=#{itemId} and s.batch_no=#{batchNo} for update
select coalesce(sum(quantity),0) from wms_stock where location_id=#{locationId}
mapper.insert: insert into wms_stock (warehouse_id,location_id,item_id,batch_no,production_date,expiry_date,quantity,locked_quantity,update_time) values (#{warehouseId},#{locationId},#{itemId},#{batchNo},#{productionDate},#{expiryDate},#{quantity},0,sysdate()) on duplicate key update quantity=wms_stock.quantity+values(quantity), production_date=coalesce(wms_stock.production_date,values(production_date)),expiry_date=coalesce(wms_stock.expiry_date,values(expiry_date)),update_time=sysdate()
mapper.update: update wms_stock set quantity=quantity-#{quantity},update_time=sysdate() where stock_id=#{stockId} and #{quantity}>0 and quantity-locked_quantity>=#{quantity}
update wms_stock set quantity=#{quantity},update_time=sysdate() where stock_id=#{stockId} and #{quantity}>=locked_quantity
